name: Expanded fault flags
decode: bit 0 = factory calibration fault; bit 1 = stack overflow; bits 2 through 15 = reserved

name: Expanded status flags
decode: bit 0 = gas generator installed; bit 1 = gas generator type valid; bit 2 = gas generator range valid; bit 3 = alarm test active; bit 4 = autotest in progress; bit 5 = autotest pass; bit 6 = cannot begin autotest; bit 7 = autotest failed; bit 8 = auto-clean active; bit 9 = auto-clean recovering; bits 10 through 15 = reserved

name: Fault flags
decode: bit 0 = gas sensor ADC read fault; bit 1 = LCD bus fault; bit 2 = SPI bus fault; bit 3 = temperature ADC read fault; bit 4 = gas sensor input fault; bit 5 = gas sensor removed; bit 6 = gas sensor memory checksum fault; bit 7 = gas sensor configuration fault or awaiting verification; bit 8 = gas generator removed; bit 9 = gas generator configuration fault; bit 10 = system setup memory checksum fault; bit 11 = alarm memory checksum fault; bit 12 = operator interface memory checksum fault; bit 13 = HART memory checksum fault; bit 14 = autotest failure; bit 15 = relay option voltage missing

name: Status flags
decode: bit 0 = caution active; bit 1 = warning active; bit 2 = alarm active; bit 3 = fault active; bit 4 = CWAF inhibit active; bit 5 = transmitter security active; bit 6 = system data log active; bit 7 = current loop output fixed; bit 8 = temperature input over range; bit 9 = temperature input under range; bit 10 = gas input over range; bit 11 = gas input under range; bit 12 = data log checksum error; bit 13 = calibration history not initialized; bit 14 = power-on delay; bit 15 = reserved

name: Blanked concentration
interpretation: IEEE-754 float32; primary displayed gas reading

name: Scaled concentration
decode: 0 = fault; 300 = inhibit; 800 = 0 percent full scale; 4000 = 100 percent full scale
